subject: Final-week courtyard Thrax kill timing, not spawn timing

derived.uncertainty: Event timestamps are decoded-frame times; reward display can lag actual death by at least a frame, so intervals are approximately ±0.1 s.

interpretation: These are six player-visible XP-and-credit reward events during sustained fighting. The six currently seeded Thrax placements were derived from target positions at different times; neither the rewards nor the sampled frames prove that six Thrax spawned together, that each reward came from a different spawn point, or that a wave/respawn timer existed.
pre_fight_edit: The same recording cuts from the camp at 384.467 seconds to the player already in the courtyard at 385.467 seconds (docs/evidence/bootcamp-courtyard-cave-approach-replay.json encounter_timing_observation.original_frames). The first visible reward at 391.533 seconds therefore cannot be timed from encounter activation or travel start.
implementation_decision: Keep the current enemy count and timing explicitly unverified until a normal native-client encounter can be compared with these six reward times and simultaneous on-screen enemies. Do not retune from this timing alone.
